summary.headline: Marathon Nextgen Q1 FY27 total income hit INR 217 crores, a multi-quarter high, with PAT of INR 52 crores and INR 900 crores of new redevelopment GDV added.
summary.overview:
Management reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR 217 crores (multi-quarter high), EBITDA of INR 66 crores and PAT of INR 52 crores. Sales on the existing portfolio were 38,000 sq ft with booking value of INR 86 crores and collections of INR 118 crores (MNRL's 40% share of Monte South); including the merged portfolio, sales were 46,000 sq ft, booking value INR 108 crores and collections INR 146 crores. Two redevelopment projects (Versova and Sewri, INR 450 crores GDV each) were added, and the company says it is debt-free with about INR 200 crores of acquisition capital after a INR 900 crore QIP. The merger with group entities is awaiting NCLT shareholder and creditor meetings in early September 2026.</overview>

segments.name: Monte South (Byculla, JV, 40% stake)
segments.commentary: Sold ~35,000 sq ft with booking value INR 125 crores and collections INR 140 crores. Tower A has OC; Tower B has RCC to 65th floor and part OC to 45th floor, with balance OC expected this FY; Tower C RCC at 28th floor.

segments.name: Marathon Nexzone (Panvel)
segments.commentary: Sold 14,000 sq ft with booking value INR 17 crores and collections INR 43 crores. Full OC received for Cedar and Daffodil towers, enabling handovers.

segments.name: Bhandup (NeoPark, NeoSquare)
segments.commentary: Sales of 8,000 sq ft with booking value INR 14 crores and collections INR 9 crores. NeoSquare has OC; NeoValley and NeoPark under construction per schedule.

segments.name: Commercial (Futurex and Millennium)
segments.commentary: Futurex combined sales ~4,000 sq ft, booking INR 19 crores, collections INR 23 crores; Futurex has OC. Millennium sold over 1,000 sq ft, booking INR 3 crores, collections INR 1 crore; under construction.

segments.name: PTC (Permanent Transit Camp) vertical
segments.commentary: Started after Kanjurmarg land acquisition in Q4 FY26, focused on Bhandup; no presales yet, but management expects some in coming quarters.

guidance_outlook: Management said FY27 outlook is positive and better than last year, but declined to give forward numbers; bookings from newly launched Bhandup and Panvel phases expected to show in coming quarters (booking recognised on registration).
Collections this year expected to be on the heavier side, supported by ready-to-move inventory (about 3-month TAT on sales at Futurex and Monte South) and percentage-completion receipts.
Surplus capital of about INR 200 crores expected to be fully deployed into new projects this FY27.
Target EBITDA margin of 30-35% for project acquisitions.

Merger: shareholder and creditor meetings planned for first week of September 2026, followed by a second NCLT hearing; completion timing uncertain, dependent on NCLT dates (management said it was not sure whether it would complete by December).
capex_capacity: Upcoming pipeline GDV: Monte South Commercial ~INR 3,400 crores; Monte South Residential Tower D ~INR 1,600 crores; Marathon Neo Series (Bhandup) ~INR 2,800 crores.
Existing portfolio estimated unsold GDV ~INR 8,000 crores.
Redevelopment additions: Versova (via subsidiary Sunset Spaces, ~1.5 acres, GDV >INR 450 crores, first society redevelopment) and Sewri (cluster redevelopment JDA, ~7,500 sq m, GDV ~INR 450 crores).
Merger to bring over 400 acres of land, several ongoing projects and ready inventory at Futurex into the listed entity.
Panvel-Karjat corridor deadline cited as December 2026; Monte South commercial to launch ~5 minutes from Futurex.
demand_pricing: Management cited strong demand at Monte South (footfalls up sharply), commercial space (limited Grade A supply near Futurex), and newly launched Bhandup and Panvel phases.
Ready-to-move inventory at Monte South Towers A and B is sold at a premium, per management.
Redevelopment selection: prime locations and strict financial metrics; management said it avoids high-premium deals that may get stuck.
PTC demand from neighbouring redevelopment projects in Bhandup; area serves western suburbs (around Malad, P-South ward), Mulund, Ghatkopar and parts of Chembur.

qa_highlights.question: What are the launch timelines for the INR 900 crore redevelopment GDV, and how much more can be added in 12-24 months?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the two new projects (Sewri and Versova, INR 450 crores each) add INR 900 crores in the quarter; no launch timeline or further 12-24 month addition was quantified.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 business outlook and which projects will drive acceleration?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give forward numbers but said the outlook is positive and better than last year, citing Monte South, commercial, and new Bhandup and Panvel phases, with bookings flowing in later quarters.

qa_highlights.question: How will collections trend over the next 2-3 quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Ready-to-move sales at Futurex and Monte South convert to collections in about 3 months; Monte South Tower C is at the 28th slab, with about 40% collection on that basis. Collections expected to be heavier this year.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other income fall this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: A Futurex investment-property floor was not sold in the quarter, so no rental/sale income was recognised from it.

qa_highlights.question: Will the amalgamation complete by December 2026 or slip into 2027?
qa_highlights.answer: Shareholder and stakeholder meetings are planned for early September, followed by a second NCLT hearing; management said it is not sure of the timeline because NCLT benches are heavily loaded.

qa_highlights.question: How large is the redevelopment pipeline beyond INR 900 crores, and how are deals selected?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Mumbai redevelopment opportunity is very large; selection focuses on prime locations and strict margin thresholds, and it avoids over-priced deals that can stall.

qa_highlights.question: How much capital will be deployed in FY27 and what return thresholds apply?
qa_highlights.answer: Target EBITDA margin 30-35% on acquisitions; about INR 200 crores of surplus capital to be fully deployed this FY.

qa_highlights.question: What is the PTC vertical's pipeline and outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: PTC business started after the Q4 FY26 Kanjurmarg land acquisition; strong demand from neighbouring redevelopments; presales may start in next few quarters.
